_readme: Domain-knowledge lookup tables for profile_columns.py's column-triage pipeline. Edit THIS FILE, not the Python code, to add a header keyword, a value synonym, or a new gene/zygosity entry. All 'pattern' fields are case-insensitive regexes (Python re syntax) matched against a column header. The Python code that CONSUMES these tables -- including the reasoning behind thresholds, exclusions, and edge cases -- stays in profile_columns.py; this file is data only.

gene.note: gene-symbol/gene-ID column. Deliberately does NOT match 'Genetic confirmation' -- the word-boundary after 'gene' requires a non-word character next, but 'genetic' continues with 't', so that column falls through to BOOLEAN instead. 'locus'/'loci'/'hgnc' cover common clinical-registry synonyms (Gene Symbol, Gene Name, Causative/Affected Gene, HGNC ID, Locus) without a bare 'symbol' pattern, which would false-positive on non-gene symbol columns.

entrez_id_header.note: Entrez Gene ID hint for numeric-ID gene columns. 'gene id'/'geneid' is NCBI's own column name for Entrez Gene ID exports, not a generic 'any gene identifier' pattern.

hgnc_id_header.note: HGNC numeric-ID hint for numeric-ID gene columns

zygosity.note: zygosity/allelic-state column (one leg of the gene/variant/zygosity triad)

variant.note: confirmatory ONLY, not definitive -- variant-column membership is decided by whether VALUES parse as HGVS/rsID notation (see VARIANT_VALUE_RE in code), because header naming for this leg of the gene/variant/zygosity triad is expected to be inconsistent across partners. When this header pattern and the value-shape test disagree, the column goes to human review rather than being auto-classified either way (decided 2026-09-23).

_date_subtype_note: ORDER MATTERS -- checked top to bottom, first match wins.

zygosity_values._readme: GENO ontology (purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_nnnnnnn) zygosity terms. 'triggers' are matched EXACT-after-normalization (lowercase, punctuation/whitespace stripped) against a cell value -- never substring -- to avoid false hits like 'heterogeneous' matching on 'het'. A value not found in ANY entry here is left unmapped for human review, not guessed at -- see 'biallelic'/'monoallelic' which are deliberately excluded (clinically overloaded, meaning varies by lab convention).

GENO_0000135.label: heterozygous
GENO_0000135.note: plain het/heterozygous ALWAYS resolves here -- never auto-inferred as compound (GENO_0000402) or simple (GENO_0000458, not in this table at all) without an explicit qualifier in the value. Decided 2026-09-23: don't guess at synonyms for terms not yet observed in partner data.

GENO_0000402.label: compound heterozygous
GENO_0000402.note: 'chet' deliberately excluded -- too collision-prone with unrelated abbreviations to trust as an exact-match trigger (2026-09-23).

GENO_0000137.label: unspecified zygosity
GENO_0000137.note: also the intended default when a gene is present with no zygosity column/value at all -- see the gene/variant/zygosity triad design notes

gene_stub_lexicon._readme: Offline stand-in for mygene.info (StubGeneResolver) -- real NMD-panel gene symbols mapped to their HGNC numeric ID, captured live from mygene.info on 2026-09-23. NOT a substitute for the live resolver; used for --offline/demo/CI runs only.

transcript_stub_lexicon._readme: Offline stand-in for mygene.info scope=refseq (StubGeneResolver, gene-from-variant path) -- unversioned RefSeq transcript accession -> gene symbol, captured live from mygene.info on 2026-09-23, all NMD-panel genes already in gene_stub_lexicon above.

rsid_stub_lexicon._readme: Offline stand-in for myvariant.info (StubMyVariantResolver) -- dbSNP rsID -> gene symbol, captured live from myvariant.info on 2026-09-23. NOT NMD-panel-specific (myvariant.info's own test examples) -- just enough to exercise the resolver offline. TP53/TNF are also added to gene_stub_lexicon below (HGNC 11998/11892, captured live) so the rsID->symbol->HGNC round trip fully resolves offline, not just the first hop.

lane_to_vartype._readme: Maps a column-triage lane to the variable-type vocabulary a generative model (DBM/VAE) would train from -- falls out of the same classification the CARE-SM mapping uses (dual-use).
